name: natural-time-input
title: NaturalTimeInput
description: A text field that reads dates, times and recurrences written in English ("every weekday at 9am") with gpu-time, and previews what it understood: the recognised words, the resolved occurrences in a time zone, a Repeats chip and the parser's notes. Put it in a Field for its label, description and error. Works on the CPU or the GPU; the package loads on first use.
